segments.name: Print
segments.description: Manufactures digital printing equipment, plates, software and consumables for commercial print, packaging and publishing industries.
segments.evidence: Print segment products include digital offset plate offerings and computer-to-plate ("CTP") imaging solutions, production press systems, consumables (primarily ink), inkjet components, software and services, and high-quality digital printing solutions using electrically charged toner-based technology.

segments.name: Advanced Materials and Chemicals
segments.description: Produces photographic film, motion picture film, specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals and advanced materials for industrial and entertainment applications.
segments.evidence: The Advanced Materials and Chemicals segment is comprised of five lines of business: the Industrial Film and Chemicals business, the Motion Picture business, the Pharmaceuticals business, the Advanced Materials and Functional Printing business and the IP Licensing and Analytical Services business.

segments.name: Brand
segments.description: Manages Kodak brand licensing and brand-related revenue activities.
segments.evidence: Kodak's operations are classified into three reportable segments: Print, Advanced Materials and Chemicals, and Brand.

segments.name: All Other
segments.description: Represents Eastman Business Park operations and other continuing operations not meeting reportable segment criteria.
segments.evidence: The balance of Kodak's continuing operations, which do not meet the criteria of a reportable segment, are reported in All Other and primarily represent the Eastman Business Park ("EBP") operations.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase printing equipment, consumables, films and chemicals directly from Kodak or through dealers and channel partners.
revenueModel.evidence: Print products are sold to customers through both a direct sales team as well as indirectly through dealers and channel partners.

changes.text: In 2022, Kodak ceased manufacturing NEXFINITY printers but continues offering consumables and service to installed base.
changes.evidence: Kodak ceased manufacturing of NEXFINITY printers effective December 2022.

changes.text: Kodak has ceased manufacturing VERSAMARK Press Systems but continues selling consumables and services to existing users.
changes.evidence: Kodak has ceased manufacturing VERSAMARK Press Systems.
